jetson._memory_mb: E4B on the Jetson peaks at +5,008 MB (worst of 4 runs, baseline and thinking). 5,400 left ~400 MB spare and refused real idle boards at 5,257, costing 10.7 h on 2026-09-24; thinking runs started at 5,238-5,239 have bottomed at 354-441 MB free. 5,200 keeps ~190 MB over the worst peak; raise it again if a run ever comes closer.
